single_operator_note: The estimates assume two people, one per hero. One operator must interleave distinct Isp A/D/W and Pac arrow-key inputs; simultaneous role work, especially holding a pad while moving the other hero, adds coordination burden. Software key mappings are distinct; physical keyboard rollover and human comfort were not tested.
